headlines.title: Dolly Parton, country music icon, dies at 80
headlines.description: Dolly Parton, who rose from a loving if impoverished upbringing in the mountains of East Tennessee to become the “Queen of Country” music, a Hollywood star and a beloved American icon, has died, her family announced on Tuesday.

headlines.title: Canada announces new tariffs on the U.S. as trade tensions rise
headlines.description: The Canadian government retaliated against President Donald Trump’s latest wave of tariffs by raising tariffs on steel products and imposing a swath of new duties on $20 billion in U.S. products exported to Canada. NBC News' Christine Romans reports on the new tariffs unveiled by Canada as the trade war with the U.S. continues.

headlines.title: Canada Prepares to Retaliate on Trump's 50% Tariffs
headlines.description: After President Donald Trump imposed 50% tariffs on some Canadian goods, Canada is saying it has leverage. “We have what the world wants,” Prime Minister Mark Carney said. Meanwhile, Trump’s pressure campaign on Iran is underway with what he calls “economic D-Day,” slapping fresh sanctions on 60 foreign entities and threatening to cut off countries unless they stop doing business with Iran. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Massachusetts: Day 20
headlines.description: Watch live coverage as the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three young children, continues in Massachusetts after the defense rested its case.

headlines.title: Trump administration says it might demolish the Kennedy Center if court blocks renovations
headlines.description: The Trump administration is, for the first time, threatening the demolition of the Kennedy Center if the arts institution isn’t allowed to close for two years for renovations.

headlines.title: Send in your questions on China, AI and robotics for Janis Mackey Frayer
headlines.description: NBC News’ correspondent, who has spent years in China, will answer reader questions in a Q&A for subscribers on Tuesday.

headlines.title: CIA director flies unannounced to Moscow to hold talks, source says
headlines.description: CIA Director John Ratcliffe flew to Russia to holds talks in Moscow Tuesday, according to a person with knowledge of the matter.

headlines.title: Kornacki Cam: Watch Steve analyze results from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff
headlines.description: NBC News chief data analyst Steve Kornacki breaks down real-time vote tallies from South Carolina's GOP Senate runoff between Darline Graham and Ralph Norman, while giving viewers a behind-the-scenes look at election night coverage.

headlines.title: Immigrant dad of USS Lincoln sailor is released from ICE detention
headlines.description: Navy sailor Joshua Aviles posted a family statement on his Facebook page that his father Luis Manuel Aviles “has been released back to our family.”

headlines.title: Abdul El-Sayed pushes back in Fox News interview: ‘Not here to fight a culture war’
headlines.description: Abdul El-Sayed, the Democratic nominee for Senate in Michigan, tangled with Fox News host Jesse Watters in an interview Monday, repeatedly pivoting from “culture war” questions to refocus on affordability in his state.
